watchlist.legalBasis: EU restrictive measures (e.g. Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014); illustrative

company_registry.legalBasis: Public company register; illustrative. In WM and Sovim (C-37/20 and C-601/20, 22 November 2022) the CJEU invalidated the AML Directive's rule giving the general public access to beneficial-ownership information, as a serious interference with Charter Arts 7 and 8. The beneficial-owner fields are therefore marked PII.
company_registry.fieldNote: beneficial_owner and beneficial_owner_dob are personal data (PII): since WM and Sovim (CJEU, 22 November 2022) they may not be open to the general public. The rest of the register stays OPEN.

flight_manifests.legalBasis: PNR Directive (EU) 2016/681, Art. 12 (five years); illustrative. In Ligue des droits humains (C-817/19, 21 June 2022) the CJEU held that keeping every passenger's data beyond the first six months is not strictly necessary without objective evidence of a risk. This dataset still keeps every row for five years.

bank_transactions.legalBasis: Anti-money-laundering record keeping, Directive (EU) 2015/849 Art. 40; illustrative

mobile_location_pings.legalBasis: Traffic data kept for billing, ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC Art. 6; illustrative

clinic_registrations.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 9(2)(h), provision of health care; medical-record retention as under the Dutch WGBO (20 years); illustrative
